summary_en: 210M shares (9.1% S/O), ¥400B ceiling, ToSTNeT-3 method, execution from Aug 3, 2026. Part of multi-year ¥2.0T buyback program announced Mar 2025; ¥600B executed in FY2025, ¥1.4T planned FY2026+, completion target FY2030.
title_en: Notice Regarding Share Acquisition Framework (Share Buyback Pursuant to Company Law Article 165(2))
translation_en_brief: On 31 July 2026, Seven & i Holdings' Board of Directors approved a buyback framework authorizing acquisition of up to 210 million shares (9.1% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) at a maximum aggregate cost of ¥400.0 billion via ToSTNeT-3 (off-exchange block trading). Execution begins 3 August 2026. This action implements a multi-year capital return program announced in the 6 March 2025 Management Update, which committed the company to ¥2.0 trillion in total buybacks by FY2030. The company executed ¥600 billion in FY2025 and plans to execute ¥1.4 trillion in FY2026 and beyond to meet the ¥2.0 trillion target. The framework was adopted under the statutory authority in Company Law Article 156 (as read through Article 165(3)) to set acquisition limits outside a specific shareholder authorization. No per-share ceiling was disclosed in the framework announcement; detailed execution terms including use of an accelerated share repurchase (ASR / facility-type) structure are referenced in a separate concurrent notice dated the same day.
